title: Portable ATAC fragments-to-matrix smoke
agent_persona: A collaborator checking whether rustscenic can process a tiny ATAC fragments file without downloading any data.
goal: Install the built wheel and run the standalone ATAC preprocessing example that asserts exact cell-by-peak counts and QC metrics.

commands.name: Build and install core wheel
commands.run:
python -m pip install --upgrade maturin
maturin build --release --manifest-path crates/rustscenic-py/Cargo.toml
WHL=$(ls target/wheels/rustscenic-*.whl | head -1)
python -m pip install "$WHL"
